## Games

### ALBA Berlin Soars Past EWE Baskets Oldenburg 95:77

*Played Saturday, 14 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

ALBA Berlin secured a convincing 95:77 victory over EWE Baskets Oldenburg on November 14, with Jordan Ford, Brandon Angel, and Joe Wieskamp all contributing 15 points each. Martin Hermannsson added 14 points, including 4 three-pointers, to the ALBA Berlin offense. The team's defense was also praised, with coach Pedro Calles noting that they played well for 30 minutes, but struggled in the final quarter. Oldenburg's coach, Milenko Bogicevic, acknowledged that his team was outplayed and needed to improve their energy and toughness. The win marked ALBA Berlin's first away victory in the BBL, and they will look to build on this momentum in their next match against FC Bayern München.

### Niners Chemnitz crush Basketball Löwen Braunschweig 111:79

*Played Sunday, 15 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

NINERS Chemnitz secured a crucial win in their battle to avoid relegation in the easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga, defeating Basketball Löwen Braunschweig 111:79. The game was played in front of nearly 4,000 fans, with Chemnitz showcasing a brilliant offensive performance. They dished out 30 assists and had six players score in double figures, including Ben Burnham with 21 points and Jannis von Seckendorff with 19 points, both setting new career highs. Phlan Fleming had a double-double with 12 points and 14 assists, while Elias Rödl made his first 100 points in the Chemnitz jersey. The win was a much-needed reaction to Chemnitz's previous three losses, and they will look to build on this momentum in their next game against Tofas Bursa. Braunschweig, on the other hand, struggled with their shooting, hitting only 34% of their field goals, and were unable to contain Chemnitz's offense, which had a 58% field goal percentage and 56.7% three-point percentage.

## European Cups

### Seawolves fall short against top EuroCup favorite Hapoel Jerusalem

In a closely contested game, the Rostock Seawolves pushed top EuroCup favorite Hapoel Jerusalem to the wire, but ultimately fell short 80-91. The Seawolves, led by Przemyslaw Frasunkiewicz, were down by as many as 17 points in the third quarter, but managed to close the gap to 5 points with just 4 minutes remaining. However, they were unable to complete the comeback, with Hapoel Jerusalem securing the win. The Seawolves were led in scoring by Copeland with 16 points and Crockett Jr. with 21 points. This was the Seawolves' sixth loss in the EuroCup, and they remain at the bottom of their group with an 0-8 record.

### Veolia Towers Host Charity Event for Cancer Research

The Veolia Towers will host a charity event on November 22nd at the Inselpark Arena against Phoenix Hagen. The event, titled 'Dreier gegen den Krebs' (Three against Cancer), will raise money for the 'Knack den Krebs' initiative, which supports cancer research at the University of Hamburg's UKE hospital. Per Günther, a former national team player and BASKETBALL AID board member, will participate in a three-point challenge, taking 15 shots from different positions. Each successful shot will increase the donation amount by 200 euros. The event is made possible by the partnership between CAPITAL CRAFTERS and the Veolia Towers, with CAPITAL CRAFTERS agreeing to cover the donation this year. The charity event aims to raise awareness and funds for cancer research in Hamburg, a cause that BASKETBALL AID and CAPITAL CRAFTERS are committed to supporting.
